query:
UPDATE external_identities
            SET provider_username = COALESCE($2, provider_username),
                provider_email = COALESCE($3, provider_email),
                last_login_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'),
                updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
            WHERE id = $1
